name: Golar Tundra / Snam Piombino FSRU terminal
description: 5 billion m3/year regasification; about 6.5% of Italian domestic gas needs; Golar leased the vessel back briefly as an LNG carrier.

milestones.event: Snam acquired Golar Tundra from Golar LNG
Golar agreed to convert and sell Golar Arctic to Snam as an FSRU
Golar reacquired Hilli common units from New Fortress Energy
SBM recorded disposal and lease reclassification for FPSO Espirito Santo

capex.metric: ASSET TRANSACTION - Golar Tundra FSRU sale price
capex.basis: Snam/Golar SEC exhibit: acquisition for US$350 million (about EUR 330 million); asset transaction, not a unit cost. Golar reported net cash proceeds of USD 193.1m after debt and fees.

capex.metric: ASSET TRANSACTION - Golar Arctic converted FSRU sale price
capex.basis: Golar Q2 2022 report read via r.jina.ai proxy: sale of converted FSRU to Snam for EUR 269.0m (about USD 288m per Golar); euro preserved as printed; asset transaction, not a unit cost.

capex.metric: CONVERSION SCOPE - Golar Arctic FSRU estimated conversion cost
capex.basis: Golar 26 May 2022 6-K exhibit read via r.jina.ai proxy: estimated conversion cost approximately USD 160m due to high specification equipment and inflationary market conditions; this IS a conversion cost figure, distinct from the sale price.

capex.metric: ASSET TRANSACTION - Golar Tundra final sale price including working capital adjustment
capex.basis: Golar Q2 2022 report note 4: agreement 31 May 2022 for Snam to acquire Golar LNG NB 13 Corporation for USD 352.5m including a USD 2.5m working capital adjustment; kept alongside the USD 350m headline price from the joint press release, not reconciled.

capex.metric: ASSET TRANSACTION - OSX-3 / Bravo FPSO purchase by PetroRio
capex.basis: Offshore Engineer reporting as previously reported in 2020: PetroRio bought the OSX-3 FPSO for USD 140m together with an 80% stake in Tubarao Martelo; asset transaction, not a unit cost.

capex.metric: ASSET TRANSACTION - FPSO Espirito Santo net disposal amount
capex.basis: SBM 2020 annual report: net disposal USD 126m = historical cost USD 584m less accumulated depreciation USD 458m; accounting disposal on lease reclassification, not a market sale price.

capex.metric: ASSET TRANSACTION - Golar Hilli common units cash component of buyback
capex.basis: Golar Q3 2023: USD 100.0m cash plus USD 116.9m of NFE shares and USD 3.9m of distribution rights; equity transaction, not a unit cost.

capex.metric: ASSET TRANSACTION - Golar net consideration for carriers and Golar Tundra
capex.basis: Golar 2023 Form 20-F read via r.jina.ai proxy: 2022 disposals of most LNG carriers and the Golar Tundra FSRU for net consideration USD 697.8m with gain USD 113.2m; portfolio transaction, not a unit cost.

sources.note: 5 billion m3/year regasification; about 6.5% of Italian domestic gas needs; Gola

gaps.what: Final completed Golar Arctic FSRU sale proceeds
gaps.why: The EUR 269m figure is the agreed sale price signed in May 2022; Golar stated ownership would not transfer for up to three years, so final proceeds were not in the read pages.
gaps.next_action: Check later Golar annual reports for completion of the Arctic conversion and sale.

gaps.what: Scope split of the USD 697.8m 2022 disposal consideration
gaps.why: The 20-F reports a combined net consideration for carriers plus Golar Tundra and a combined gain.
gaps.next_action: Use the separately reported Golar Tundra USD 350m/352.5m figures for the FSRU component; no further split asserted.
